Topic at a Glance
Article 338A of the Constitution of India is titled “National Commission for Scheduled Tribes”. It forms an integral component of Special Provisions relating to Certain Classes (Articles 330–342A), located within the “Commissions” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
